chunks: And ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about vomit that gets on the garment and is not washed, so he said:
There is no harm in it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.السَّابَاطِيُّ: al-Sābāṭī, the attribution of the narrator
key_terms.عَمَّارٌ: ʿAmmār, the narrator asking the legal question
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is not problematic

ai.seo_question: Is vomit on clothing considered impure and does it need to be washed?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding vomit on clothing. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it, indicating that such vomit does not require washing from the garment in this context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.8 - Ammar al-Sabati asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about vomit that gets on clothing and is not washed off.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in it."
